product_boundaries: Readiness workflow only; no compliance certification.
FDA-style sortable export language is allowed, but no FDA endorsement.
No legal advice or automated exemption determination.
Keep the product a lightweight traceability workflow layer, not ERP.

remaining_absences: No route-wired database connection, repository business logic, or runtime persistence; a lazy PostgreSQL client seam exists but is not requested by routes.
No production authentication provider; exception-review PATCH uses local/test fixture bearer auth only.
No runtime tenant provider; the Drizzle tenant_memberships schema exists but tenants are still server-derived fixture values only.
No production RBAC provider; exception-review PATCH enforces the same-tenant fixture reviewer role only.
No runtime persisted audit log; the Drizzle audit_events schema exists but exception-review PATCH appends in-memory fixture audit events only.
No runtime persisted traceability records; the Drizzle traceability_exceptions schema exists but exception-review PATCH mutates a deterministic in-memory fixture exception only.
No persisted or storage-backed mock-recall runtime payloads beyond the contract smoke fixture.
